canonicalSpatialBasis.rule: one spatial identity; time never creates another world

storageModel.compressionRule: quantized coordinates + sparse masks/residual patches + source identity/hash; no duplicated full rasters
storageModel.sizeGoal: preserve the existing approximately 2.x MiB canonical core; historical epochs should add only sparse deltas, not another core

activeEpoch.rule: finish this short historical window before adding later decades

historicalEvidence.precedence: finer local evidence overrides coarse atlas inside its verified footprint
historicalEvidence.displayRule: raw extraction/control geometry is nonvisual; users see reconstructed historical state, not engineering guide lines

truthBoundary.historicalCoast: may be inferred between reliable map controls when the inference is recorded and reversible
truthBoundary.bathymetry: do not promote inferred seabed heights to observed truth; store observed/derived/confidence separately
truthBoundary.reservoir: remove modern water/dam when historical absence is secure; pre-reservoir valley elevation remains derived until supported
truthBoundary.minorFeatures: absence on 1:250000 sheets is not evidence that small roads, bridges, drains or buildings did not exist
